Quest name: Different Form of Sacred Nails
Quest location: Rio de Janeiro Adventurers' Guild
Skill requirement: r15 Search, r17 Theology, ITA(Italian)
Pre-requisite discovery: The Holy Cross discovery (from "Object of faith" quest) + The Spear of Longinus discovery (from "The spear of Longinus" quest)
Pre-requisite action: Priest's Growth 1 skill must be activated in order to see the quest
